settings_navigation.policy: Settings is the App-owned OPL Control Center information architecture, not an upstream AionUI configuration dump. The target ordinary IA is Overview, Access, Workspace, Capabilities, Resources & Connections, Maintenance & Updates, Data & Storage, and Preferences. Existing shell route ids general, access, workspace, capabilities, resources, environment, storage, and appearance map to those ordinary groups. Advanced, About, Update, Theme, and Local Services are secondary or deep-link routes. Capabilities is an installed package directory with integrated Home shortcut management; purpose labels remain secondary tags and filters, not the primary card identity. About is version-and-links only and remains a secondary Advanced surface. Update is an explicit detail or deep-link destination for update state, while normal repair and maintenance actions stay under Maintenance & Updates. Maintenance must not become a second runtime task board. Theme remains a secondary page or deep link, not an independent ordinary top-level group. Storage lifecycle and safe cleanup live under Data & Storage. Workspace is an independent ordinary setup concern, not a buried runtime diagnostic. Resources & Connections is an ordinary route for Docker WebUI, OPL Workspace, managed resources, SSH/HPC, Fabric, and Console-managed refs so Access stays focused on OPL Gateway, Codex CLI, and browser access to this computer. Legacy upstream settings routes remain compatibility redirects only; they must not reappear as ordinary navigation.
